root_cause: Growth Swarm runtime was live but its public calculators and benchmark value proposition were not yet exposed on a canonical website route.
decision: Expose the Growth Lab on /groei using the already-live Growth Tools Edge Function, preserve privacy/truth boundaries, route to Frisse Blik, and index the page in the sitemap.
prevention: A newly introduced public growth tool is incomplete until it has a canonical public route or an explicit internal-only designation.
Public benchmark surfaces must fail closed when sample/privacy floors are not met.
Scenario financial outputs and M&A risk outputs must remain labelled as estimates.
Public Growth Lab must not expose private Revenue Swarm account intelligence.
evidence: Growth Swarm runtime and Growth Tools were already live before this website candidate.
The candidate adds a canonical /groei route backed by the existing Growth Tools API.
The page fails closed when benchmark sample/privacy thresholds are not met.
Regression test binds route, calculators, truth labels and Frisse Blik conversion handoff.
